skipSemantics: May-skip, not must-skip: a listed test that runs and passes on a machine where its precondition holds is green. Matching is exact on the pre-'(' portion of the TRX result testName (xunit theory rows serialize with arguments, e.g. Class.Method(x: 1)); a name with no parens matches whole. Anchor is the TRX result list, never Counters arithmetic.
admissionRule: allowedSkips is not a quarantine list. A test may be listed only when its precondition is a property of the machine or OS that cannot be satisfied by configuration during a contract run, and its change names the machine class where it executes. Two named PERMANENT BANS apply: (1) CcpClient.Tests.DataRootOverrideTests.DefaultSettingsPath_EnvUnset_IsThePlatformDefault must never be allowed to skip because a process-wide CCP_DATA_ROOT override makes the floor vacuous; (2) CcpClient.Tests.ChaosTunnelLoopbackTests.Logging_RouteClassesOnly_NeverFilenameOrQuery must be fixed at the source, never quarantined.
bumpRule: Bump total only in the same commit as the test change that moves the count, with the reason recorded here. Never widen, disable, or special-case a check to make a step pass. Adding a name to allowedSkips requires the admission rule above and the machine class where it executes.
lastMovedBy: +2 unit, headless unchanged at 264: TWO GUARD ROWS CLOSED - and in both cases the row's named work already existed while the real hole was somewhere else. THE 66-FACT ROW was done by hand a day earlier; what was left is that NOTHING BOUND THE CONVENTION, and the telling evidence is that five NEW real-desktop classes landed the day after and every one followed it - which is what made binding it the right move rather than rewriting anything. The guard is at FILE granularity deliberately, because a per-fact rule would have to resolve a class-level alias AND would red the platform-independent facts, i.e. fire on correct code. Its one exemption carries its reason and reds as STALE if the exempted class ever gains a key, because an exemption nobody re-reads is a hole with a comment; and blinding the key list reds 19 classes, so the pass is over 19 complying classes rather than an empty set. THE WAIT-COVERAGE ROW likewise already had its deliverable; the live hole is that a budget HOISTED INTO A FIELD can be passed POSITIONALLY under any spelling and both guards go blind - not hypothetical, because the 200ms teardown bound landed unreviewed as ShortBound, matching none of the five needle words, passed positionally into the host that waits on it. A census of all 14 named TimeSpan constants bound from a wall-clock literal now classifies each with its reason; ShortBound STAYS, because its elapsing IS its fact - what was missing was any record that a human decided so. A renamed constant forces the table to be re-read, and a blinded regex reds naming the count. A REAL BUG THE MUTATION CAUGHT IN THE LANE'S OWN GUARD: its first draft counted only classified sites for the non-vacuity control, so a genuine finding would have tripped the generic blind-regex message instead of the named file:line one. AND A HAZARD RAISED AGAINST ITS OWN RESULT, filed separately: a KEYED vacuity control can itself be skipped, so a real-desktop class can be green on Linux with nothing measured - the new guard removes only the class that keys nothing and says so in its own doc.
